text: mujhe pichle do din se bahut tez bukhar chadha hua hai
meri maa ko seene mein bahut dard ho raha hai aur pasina aa raha hai
bachche ko saans lene mein bahut takleef ho rahi hai
gaon mein kisi ko saanp ne kaat liya
dast lage hain aur kamzori bhi bahut hai
kal se sar mein dard hai aur chakkar bhi aa rahe hain
peshab mein bahut jalan hoti hai
bukhar nahi hai par khansi bahut hai
teen hafte se khansi aur raat ko bukhar
pet bahut dard kar raha hai aur ulti ho rahi hai
usko mirgi ka daura aaya aur wo behosh ho gaya
mere jodon me bahut dard hai aur ghutne sooj gaye hain
sans phool rahi hai aur chhati me dard hai
